title: Electrotransformation of Clostridium species
author: Chin Yee Tan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zvsf66e

steps.title: Prepare overnight starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 10 µL BHI‑supplemented broth with 100 µL stock culture and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Inoculate main culture to OD 0.02
steps.instruction: Add an appropriate volume of the overnight culture to 100 mL BHI‑supplemented broth to obtain a starting optical density of 0.02.

steps.title: Harvest cells at early exponential phase
steps.instruction: Grow the culture to early‑exponential phase (OD 0.2–0.25), then centrifuge at 12 000 g for 15 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Wash cells in SML buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL SML electroporation buffer and centrifuge once to wash.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in SMP buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 10 mL SMP electroporation buffer.

steps.title: Mix DNA and electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for electroporation by mixing DNA and applying the pulse.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 400 µL of the cell suspension, add 500 ng of DNA, and transfer the mixture to a pre‑chilled cuvette with a 0.2 cm gap.
Incubate the cuvette on ice for 10 min.
Electroporate using 25 µF capacitance, 200 Ω resistance, and 1.8 kV voltage.

steps.title: Recover cells in BHI broth
steps.instruction: Immediately add the electroporated cells to 10 mL BHI broth and incubate for 3 h.

steps.title: Plate cells on selective agar
steps.instruction: Plate appropriate dilutions of the recovered culture on solid BHI agar with and without the selective agent.
